subject.title: Beta blocker: official plugins - core update removes loadSessionStore

question: Should the beta restore a bounded `loadSessionStore` compatibility export for the official-plugin upgrade window, or wait for coordinated republishing of every affected plugin?
rationale: The regression is established, but maintainers must choose the supported beta upgrade contract and the compatibility removal window.

options.title: Restore bounded compatibility
options.body: Add a read-only accessor-backed export, migrate affected official plugins, and remove it after an explicitly supported beta window.

options.title: Coordinate plugin republish
options.body: Hold the beta until every affected official plugin is republished and survivor upgrades no longer import the old symbol.

recommendation.title: Restore bounded compatibility
recommendation.body: Add a read-only accessor-backed export, migrate affected official plugins, and remove it after an explicitly supported beta window.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned reporter owns the beta blocker and is best positioned to coordinate the core and official-plugin release window.
